events.title: Storyblok founded
events.summary: Dominik Angerer and Alexander Feiglstorfer founded Storyblok in Linz, Austria in 2017 — a headless [CMS] with a visual editor for marketers and component APIs for developers.
events.about: Storyblok's block-based visual editor let content teams compose pages from developer-defined components — bridging the marketer-developer gap that pure [API] CMSs left open. It became a leading European headless [CMS] for enterprises like Adidas and Pizza Hut.

narrative.whyChosen: Storyblok pioneered visual editing in a headless [CMS] without sacrificing developer control.
narrative.whyImportant: Component-based content blocks influenced how headless CMSs serve both marketers and engineers.
narrative.problemSolved: Headless CMSs forced marketers to edit [JSON] or rely entirely on developers for layout changes.

events.title: GraphCMS founded
events.summary: Michael Lukaszczyk and Daniel Winter founded GraphCMS in Germany in 2017 (GmbH registered June 2017) — the first GraphQL-native headless [CMS], later rebranded Hygraph.
events.about: GraphCMS built its content [API] on GraphQL from day one — typed schemas, nested queries, and federation for omnichannel content. It competed with [REST]-first headless CMSs and later rebranded to Hygraph in 2022 as the platform expanded beyond pure [CMS].

narrative.whyChosen: GraphCMS made GraphQL the native [API] for headless content management.
narrative.whyImportant: It validated GraphQL as the query layer for structured content at enterprise scale.
narrative.problemSolved: [REST] [CMS] APIs required multiple round-trips for nested content relationships.
